name: Kurumai Mikuru
source:
The Enigmatic Beauty Behind the Mask

Arata's classmate in his new school, Mikuru, is not much of a talker and rarely shows her emotions. Coupled with the fact that she's always wearing a mask, she's definitely someone who stands out in class. Mikuru doesn't put on airs to impress anyone, and her unique vibe has earned her the reputation of being an icy, unapproachable beauty.

Point: Ego boosts from dating such a mysterious and captivating presence
Going home style: Systematic. There is a regular pattern to what she does and when.

"Going home with me isn't fun, is it?"

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/houkago2/character-3.html]official website[/url]]
